<details>
This PKGBUILD extracts Microsoft Windows 10 fonts from an official evaluation ISO using range‑request proxy and rclone, with a full‑ISO fallback. The custom `DLAGENTS` entries (`/usr/bin/bash -c :>"$0"`) are **not** malicious—they create empty placeholder files to prevent makepkg's default downloader from fetching the ISO and font files, because the actual extraction is handled separately in `prepare()`. This is a known AUR technique to avoid redundant network transfers. The only external network destination is Microsoft's official download server (`software-static.download.prss.microsoft.com`). No obfuscated code, backdoors, or data exfiltration is present. All operations (range‑proxy setup, rclone mount, 7z extraction, file verification) are standard packaging practices for this type of font package. The file is safe.
</details>
